scope: saved Phase 8 test predictions and frozen train/test manifests; descriptive only

method_notes.symbol_analysis: NFD Unicode code points, evaluator tie order M/S/D/I; substitutions and deletions assigned to reference symbols; insertions counted as output symbols without a reference denominator. Alignment paths can be ambiguous.
method_notes.repetition_fraction: Repeated code-point trigrams after their first occurrence divided by all trigrams. Descriptive; natural repetition may also raise this measure.
method_notes.component_labels: Anonymous labels sorted by decreasing held-out clip count; private IDs and mapping excluded.
method_notes.causality: Training frequency, recording group, length and errors are associated; no causal attribution or test-based selection.
